translated_text: Celum. Heipa 17. 3.37 Zabis, – I don't know what to write to you in response to his letter, what to write to you again. When I think of us, everything inside me spins. I can't stand it anymore. But we can't go on like this. It's as if we're always circling around a point, never meeting it, and never getting away from it. Zabis, my dear, it has to change. No matter how. You'll think, "Not the same old thing again," we talk about it, make firm resolutions, and everything stays the same. – But it really shouldn't stay the same. Demand this decision from me, we'll both go into this circle. It really only takes a little energy, and we both owe that to each other. In the worst case, it's better an end with horror than a horror without end. Zabalein, I can take 8-10 days off at Easter. But 4 of those days are travel, so we can see each other for a maximum of 6 days. Dear, I thought, before this short time; A few weeks later it's better and longer. I have the 8th will then be more money. The days in London would cost 4000 francs, since the trip via Switzerland costs almost 2500 francs. I really think it's better if we are together for a few weeks and it's nicer. Weeks later, I'm not going to Switzerland because we are doing everything very businesslike. Pista wrote me a very nice letter, in French, and I understood every word without looking it up. I was also very proud of that. The poor guy doesn't have it easy right now either. I tried to get something for him in half an hour, but unfortunately received a negative reply. I will definitely keep looking for anyone who comes to the next meeting. I like to love you. I will always look lovingly into your eyes and give you a firm kiss from your Bob. Kisses, Ms. Elisabeth Aigner, London NW6, 42 Vale Court, Honeybourne Road. Bob Zweigenthal Prague Ruska 48 103 calon Jg. SW 1 9271 . مال Cent 83 41 1752
